args.title: Issue 4410: change src/config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The issue is caused because TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES is expected to be an integer number of minutes, not a string like '12h'. The src/config.ts file reads this variable using the int() function which parses it as an integer, so '12h' is incorrectly parsed as 12 minutes, causing early sign-out. This explains the issue of wrong token lifetime.

args.title: Issue 4412: change src/api/health.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

This file implements the /api/v1/health endpoint. The response status is always HTTP 200 when checks.queue is 'degraded', while the API returns 503 only when the db check is 'down'. This matches the issue that the probe gets 200 but the status is 'degraded', which can lead to unclear health interpretation.

args.title: Issue 4423: change src/i18n/index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale in src/i18n/index.ts ignores the q weights in the Accept-Language header. It just iterates over languages in order and returns the first supported language regardless of quality value, thus ignoring the weight and causing the issue where French with higher q is ignored for English with lower q.
